meta.title: Geometry sweep v0: search for maximum mode locking (no source)
meta.status: search, not a prediction; v0 estimated physics; nothing measured; no source (every mode energy 0)
meta.scoring:
two modes i, j of DIFFERENT cavities lock when |f_i - f_j| <= (f_i/Q_i + f_j/Q_j)/2,
i.e. their own model linewidths (FWHM f/Q) overlap at half maximum. No tolerance is invented. Pairs scored: B-Q, B-T,
Q-T, B-S. Q-S and T-S are not scored (S contains Q and T, so they would match themselves).
Boundary-reflection round trips: a round trip inside one cavity (B: across the diameter and back, f = n c/(4a);
Q: n cL/(2w); T: n cL2/(2 t2)) lands on a real mode of ANOTHER cavity when |f_rt - f_mode| <= (f_mode/Q_mode)/2
(a reflection has no Q of its own: width 0). Targets: B -> Q, T, S; Q -> B, T; T -> B, Q.
Score = number of locks (mode-mode + reflection landings). Also reported: distinct real modes taking part, and
locks per real mode in the window (density-normalised, because a larger body simply has more modes in the window).
Cascade holding together (gate, reported per geometry): in each cavity thermal < acoustic fundamental < electric.
Knees crossed at the right thresholds: NOT SCORED. A knee crossing needs a field amplitude, and with no source every
amplitude is exactly zero; it stays unscored until a source is defined.
meta.golden: secondary non-scoring column: adjacent ratios of sorted distinct sharp-lock frequencies vs 1.618
meta.knees: unscored: knee crossings need a field amplitude; with no source every amplitude is exactly 0
meta.gas_Q: gas-cavity Q not in the model: linewidth 0 [est]
meta.refine: top 5 coarse seeds, phi^(1/8) steps, +-2 per axis, clipped to the box
meta.ranking: cascade gate first (thermal < acoustic < electric in every cavity), then primary: score (number of locks), tie-break distinct modes; secondary: sharp locks (not density-guaranteed)
